item.title: BTS' Jungkook channels ’90s cool in Calvin Klein’s Spring 2026 denim campaign
item.description: Calvin Klein has unveiled its Spring 2026 denim campaign, starring BTS' Jungkook in a new chapter dedicated to the brand’s most iconic fabric. Shot and directed by Mert Alas, the campaign blends fashion with movement, spotlighting Jungkook’s natural charisma through a high-impact film that fuses choreography, music, and stripped-back styling.
